content:
Ava: Heads-up 10:00UTC10:30UTC window shows >30 leads lingering in HubSpot 'queued' after enrichment. some >90m.
Priya: saw the alert. are these failing enrichment runs or assignment race? any SFDC rejects?
Diego: quick check: enrichment service returned 200s but payload missing region for a subset. SFDC owner mapping has strict region constraint so assignment aborted.
Nora: ok that makes sense. which sources? webinar, webinar-ad, trial?
Ava: mostly webinar and partner-trial. leads should go RR then fallback to marketing-inbound within SLA.
Sam: current RR timeout is 40m; SLA says owner by 30m. can we reduce to 10m for webinar/trial and run canary 5%?
Priya: +1 for lower timer. also want an extra normalization step to map country codes and blank regions to 'unknown' so SFDC mapping can route to pooled owner.
Diego: plan: (1) set RR timer = 600s for webinar|trial canary 5%, (2) add normalization function to enrichment pipeline (map iso2->region, default 'unknown'), (3) fallback chain marketing-inbound -> regional-ops -> pooled-sales.
Ava: please add a Slack notify when fallback triggers with age and enrichment_attempts. @sales should get a digest so reps know to claim.
Diego: sample notify payload I'll push: {"leadId": "<id>", "age_minutes": "<age>", "enrichment_attempts": "<n>", "fallback_step":"marketing-inbound"}
LeadsBot: Export ready 1984501234-queued.csv (32 rows) 198450 export link: https://hubspot.example/exports/1984501234-queued.csv
Nora: I'll scan the export for common country codes and open a quick mapping PR if pattern matches.
Priya: FYI SFDC connector errors show: "Region mapping failed: null" for 12 leads. tracker: https://jira.redwood/browse/REVOPS-928
Sam: I'll update the inbound-handoff playbook to reflect the new 10m threshold and fallback chain. will include roll-out checklist and communications for Sales.
Diego: enabling canary 5% at 10:45UTC for webinar/trial only. monitoring widgets: assignment_latency_p50/p95, fallback_rate, enrichment_fail_rate.
Ava: set alert if fallback_rate > 3% in the first hour. also mark any lead >60m as high priority in UI.
LeadsBot: Alert 1984501234 10:52UTC assignment latency p95 = 54m for affected cohort. digest posted to #marketing #sales-ops.
Priya: investigating SFDC rejects now, will post root cause in 20m. if mapping PR lands we can ramp canary to 25%.
Sam: small ops ask: @Diego please add a changelog entry and notify RevOps mailing list when ramp hits 25%+.
Diego: will create changelog PR and add rollback playbook. PR: https://gh.redwood/revops/rr-1984501234
Ava: thanks team. next update here after Priya confirms mapping fix or by EOD whichever first. remember to cc sales-ops on playbook PR.
